summary: FitFlow AI backend + frontend validated against public preview URL. Backend: 17/21 pytest tests pass (81%). All 4 failures share a single root cause: naive vs aware datetime comparison in /app/backend/streak_utils.py:59 and /app/backend/server.py:111 (MongoDB returns tz-naive datetimes, code compares with tz-aware utcnow). This bug breaks GET /api/streak (500), POST /api/workout/session (500 — calls update_weekly_streak), data-isolation test (depends on session creation), and brute-force lockout (returns 500 instead of 429 after 5 failed logins because locked_until is stored naive and compared to aware utcnow). AI endpoints (scan-meal, scan-fridge, meal-suggestions), auth, profile, nutrition, plan, exercises, ranking, meals are all green. Frontend web preview loads fine on mobile viewport, landing + login + dashboard render correctly with disclaimers, but bottom tab buttons lack testIDs and dashboard 'CURRENT PLAN' card shows 'No plan' for demo user because the /streak 500 rejects Promise.all in dashboard load() (no .catch on /streak call).

critical.issue: 500 TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes at streak_utils.py:59 (`last_eval < prev_start`). Fix: make `last_eval` tz-aware when read from Mongo, or initialize AsyncIOMotorClient with tz_aware=True.
Returns 500 for demo user due to same bug — create_workout_session calls update_weekly_streak which fails at streak_utils.py:59. Blocks the core 'log workout' flow.

After 5 failed attempts returns 500 instead of 429. Root cause in server.py:111 `attempt_doc['locked_until'] > utcnow()` — locked_until is stored naive, utcnow() is aware. Fix the same way (tz_aware=True on AsyncIOMotorClient, or wrap all comparisons).

ui_bugs.issue: Shows 'No plan / 0 days / week' for demo user even though GET /api/workout/plan returns a 4-day plan. Caused by /streak 500: Promise.all in dashboard.tsx:21 has no .catch on api.get('/streak'), so the whole aggregation rejects and no data is set. Wrap /streak with .catch(() => null) like the other calls.
Tab buttons have no testID props (tab-home / tab-workouts / tab-nutrition / tab-ranking / tab-profile expected by QA). Add `tabBarButtonTestID` or `tabBarTestID` per Tabs.Screen.

integration_issues.issue: Streak 500 propagates and wipes the dashboard state aggregation.

action_items: Fix timezone-naive vs timezone-aware datetime comparisons. Recommended: in /app/backend/server.py change `AsyncIOMotorClient(mongo_url)` to `AsyncIOMotorClient(mongo_url, tz_aware=True)` so all datetimes from Mongo come back as UTC-aware. Then GET /api/streak, POST /api/workout/session, and the 429 lockout path will all work.

In /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/dashboard.tsx line 22, change `api.get('/streak')` to `api.get('/streak').catch(() => null)` so a streak failure doesn't kill the whole dashboard fetch (immediate mitigation until the backend fix lands).
Add testIDs to Tabs.Screen so QA can locate each bottom tab: add `tabBarButtonTestID: 'tab-home'` (RN >=0.70) or wrap with a custom tabBarButton that forwards testID.

Nice-to-have: verify `locked_until` / `last_evaluated_week_start` docs are consistently written with tz-aware utcnow (models/utcnow helper looks correct — problem is on read-side, so the client-level tz_aware=True is the cleanest fix).
critical_code_review_comments: streak_utils.py:59 and server.py:111 both compare datetimes without normalizing tz — any record that roundtrips through Mongo will blow up. Standardize by enabling AsyncIOMotorClient(tz_aware=True) at client construction.
Dashboard Promise.all (/streak) lacks .catch — makes a single 5xx cascade into 'empty dashboard'. Pattern should be consistent across all 5 aggregated calls.
Bottom tabs have no testIDs — blocks automated QA coverage.
Frontend .env uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (correct), not EXPO_BACKEND_URL; system prompt mentions EXPO_BACKEND_URL — tests used EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL as source of truth.
server.py (651 lines) is large; consider splitting into routers (auth/profile/workout/nutrition/ai) for maintainability.

rca_of_issue: Mongo (via Motor) returns tz-naive datetimes by default. Code paths that wrote with datetime.now(timezone.utc) and then compared the read-back value to another tz-aware datetime raise `TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes`. Two call sites confirmed: (1) streak_utils.py line 59 `last_eval < prev_start`, (2) server.py line 111 `attempt_doc['locked_until'] > utcnow()`. Impact: streak endpoint 500, workout session POST 500 (via update_weekly_streak), brute-force lockout returns 500 instead of 429, dashboard plan card breaks. Mitigation: instantiate `AsyncIOMotorClient(mongo_url, tz_aware=True)` in server.py, or normalize on read (replace tzinfo=timezone.utc). Confirmed by stack traces in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log.
